analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: We may share your information as necessary with our third-party service providers to provide our services to you. To the extent that we share your information with certain advertising, marketing, or analytics vendors, this can be considered a “sale” or “share” in certain U.S. States, which you may have the right to opt out of.

analysis.headline: Shares with Business Partners
analysis.quote: We may disclose information about you to our subsidiaries and independent contractors who need the information to help us provide our Services or process the information on our behalf.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Sites
analysis.quote: Automattic uses cookies and other technologies like pixel tags to help us identify and track visitors, usage, and access preferences for our Services, as well as track and understand email campaign effectiveness and to deliver targeted ads.

analysis.headline: Collects Data from Third Parties
analysis.quote: We may also get information about you from other sources. For example: Third Party Login: If you create or log in to your WordPress.com account through another service (like Google) we’ll receive associated login information (e.g. a connection token, your username, your email address).

analysis.headline: Your Public Profile is Visible
analysis.quote: Your public profile information is just that — public — so please keep that in mind when deciding what information you would like to include.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Sensitive Data
analysis.quote: You may also provide us with demographic information when required by law or to support our diverse workplace initiatives, such as your gender, racial or ethnic origin, veteran status, and disability status if you voluntarily submit such information as part of your application.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Long-Term
analysis.quote: Please keep in mind that we may continue to retain your information after closing your account, as described in How Long We Keep Information above — for example, when that information is reasonably needed to comply with (or demonstrate our compliance with) legal obligations such as law enforcement requests, or reasonably needed for our legitimate business interests.

analysis.headline: Shares Data with Government
analysis.quote: We may disclose information about you in response to a subpoena, court order, or other governmental request.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: Because Automattic’s Services are offered worldwide, the information about you that we process when you use the Services in the EU or the UK may be used, stored, and/or accessed by individuals operating outside the European Economic Area (EEA) or the UK who work for us, other members of our group of companies, or third-party data processors.
